company.name: Maritime Fusion
company.shortDescription: Maritime Fusion specializes in the development and construction of high-temperature superconducting fusion reactors.
company.description: Maritime Fusion develops fusion-based power systems intended for marine and remote-energy operations. Its core product concept features compact tokamak reactors that use high-temperature superconducting magnets to generate continuous power for vessel propulsion and onboard electricity. The company also creates superconducting cable assemblies for power transmission within fusion systems and marine electrical networks. Its services cover reactor design support and integration planning for organizations assessing fusion-powered maritime applications.

productsAndServices.description: A high-temperature superconducting tokamak fusion reactor designed for marine propulsion, providing emission-free energy at power levels suitable for commercial shipping and defense applications.
productsAndServices.name: Maritime Fusion Reactor for Ships
